# ship-runtime

Your interface to the `runtime` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`runtime.list_procs`](references/docs/runtime.list_procs.mdoc) — List the daemon's tracked child processes (agents, executors).
